why we are alive at all?
工作、賺錢、置業、養妻活兒
Working, earning, buying a home, raising a family
生命 : 長度 : 濃度，到底為了甚麼?
Life : Length : Depth — for what, exactly?
最後，我們只能成為其中一個被記錄的數字嗎？
In the end, are we just another number in a record?
C O N T I N U E
If you were suddenly taken in your sleep
What would you hold on to most?
從來沒有認真想過這個問題
have never really thought about it
直到來不及想的那一天
until the day it is too late
Do you believe that after death
什麼都沒有，人死如燈滅
Nothing — the candle simply goes out
輪迴轉世，繼續下一段旅程
Reincarnation, on to the next journey
天堂或地獄，靈魂是永存，今生如單程票
Heaven or hell, the soul is eternal, this life a one-way ticket
不知道，沒認真想過，也不想思想
I don't know, never really thought about it, and don't want to
If after death there is nothing
一生的掙扎，義人的善，惡人的惡，意義何在？
A lifetime of struggle — the good of the righteous, the evil of the wicked: what sense?
為什麼人還會恐懼死亡？
為什麼人還會被套著無形的枷鎖？
Why would anyone be chained by invisible shackles?
it already knows it is not that simple
The sea of suffering is boundless — turn back and find the shore
The law that frees us from this sea of suffering
Why not find a way straight to eternity?
如果真的有天堂和地獄
If heaven and hell are real
份量是多少？誰來定標準？
How much is enough? Who sets the standard?
世界也鮮有人提真心討論
The world rarely discusses it in earnest
But it doesn't mean the question isn't there
You can choose not to think about it
雖暫不確定死亡的去處
Even if the destination of death is uncertain
it is certain that everyone must die
卻沒人在乎，這不奇怪嗎？
nobody cares — is that not strange?
Perhaps we have thought about it
and then forgotten it in the busyness
while deep down we always knew
這事一直令我們都措手不及...
and it always catches us unprepared...
「其實明天如何，我們還不知道。
"As for tomorrow, we do not know what it will bring.
我們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。」
We are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes."
「神愛世人，甚至將祂的獨生子賜給他們
"For God so loved the world that He gave His only Son,
叫一切信祂的，不致滅亡，反得永生。」
that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life."
More than 2,000 years ago, there was a man
祂沒有任何過犯，卻被釘死在十字架上
He had done no wrong, yet was crucified
為贖盡我們的過犯，除淨我們的罪孽，祂便甘心為我們捨去祂自己
To atone for our sins and cleanse us of our guilt, He willingly gave Himself for us
祂雖然曾經死過，但現在已復活了
He died, but He is alive again
並且，祂應許必定會再來提接一切相信祂的人
and He promised He would return to receive all who believe in Him
祂說: 「我就是道路、真理、生命
He said: "I am the way, and the truth, and the life.
若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。」
No one comes to the Father except through me."
主耶穌基督，我相信祢是獨一的真 神
Lord Jesus Christ, I believe You are the one true God.
謝謝祢的愛，我相信祢為贖我的罪
Thank You for Your love. I believe You died for my sins,
曾被釘死在十字架上，但已經復活了！
were crucified on the cross, and You have risen again!
我承認自己曾經做錯了許多事，求祢赦免我一切的過犯。
I confess I have done many wrong things. Please forgive all my wrongdoing.
親愛的主耶穌，我願意接受祢作我唯一的救主。
Dear Lord Jesus, I am willing to receive You as my only Saviour.
我願意打開我的心，求祢進到我的生命裡
I am willing to open my heart and invite You into my life.
求祢成為我的救主，我的拯救，永遠與我同在！
Be my Saviour, my salvation, and stay with me always!
求祢帶領我走在祢永生的路上
Lead me along Your path of eternal life.
奉主耶穌基督的名禱告，阿們！
In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, Amen!
如果你真心這樣禱告了。恭喜您! 你已經成為 神的兒女了!
If you have prayed this in your heart, congratulations — you are now a child of God!
死亡不再是終點，而是回天家的大門。願我們在天家裡相見，願主祝福你，阿們
Death is no longer the end; it is the gate home. May we meet in our Father's house, and may the Lord bless you. Amen
祂是笑臉幫助我們，是不斥責人的 神，祂以我們的默念為甘甜。
He is the God who helps with a smile, the God who does not reproach, and who takes our silent meditation as sweetness.
我們既然藉著主耶穌基督得與　神和好，也就藉著他以　神為樂
Since we have been reconciled to God through Jesus Christ, we have joy in God through him,
真實地可以與祂一同生活，一起面對所有問題
so that we may truly live with him and face all our problems together,
相信祂的應許，盼望祂再來的那天來到。
trusting in his promise and looking forward to the day he comes again.
願主祝福你，使你能夠深深認識祂，相信祂。
The Lord bless you, so that you may know him deeply and believe in him.
祂必喜悅你以真誠和愛心去回應祂的真情。
He will be pleased with you as you respond to his love with sincerity and love.
願我們一起同走這永生之路，在天家裡相見，阿們。
May we walk this eternal road together and meet in our Father's house. Amen.

生有時，死有時；栽種有時，拔出所栽種的也有時。
A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted.
其實明天如何，你們還不知道。你們的生命是甚麼呢？你們原來是一片雲霧，出現少時就不見了。
As for tomorrow, we do not know what it will bring. What is our life? We are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
你們要謹慎行事，不要像愚昧人，當像智慧人。要愛惜光陰，因為現今的世代邪惡。
Be prudent, like sensible people, not like fools. Make the most of your time, for these are evil days.
按著定命，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。
As it is appointed to man, that he must die once, and after that come judgment.
凡有血氣的盡都如草；他的美容都像野地的花。草必枯乾，花必凋殘。
All flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man is as the flower of the field: the grass withereth, and the flower fadeth.
神愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不致滅亡，反得永生。
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
人若賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own life? or what shall a man give in exchange for his life?
💭 如果今天是你生命的最後一天，你會做什麼？
💬 If today were the last day of your life, what would you do?
💭 你最害怕的是死亡本身，還是死後的未知？
💬 What do you fear more — death itself, or the unknown after it?
💬 What are you grateful for today?
💭 你是在「活著」還是在「生存」？
💬 Are you living, or merely surviving?
💭 如果你只剩一年的生命，你會如何重新安排優先次序？
💬 If you had one year left, how would you reorder your priorities?
💭 你覺得自己活得有意義嗎？如果不是，什麼才是有意義的人生？
💬 Do you think your life is meaningful? If not, what would a meaningful life be?
生命不在於長短，而在於深度。
Life is not measured by its length, but by its depth.
「有些人25歲就死了，但是要75歲才被埋葬。」(如行屍走肉的一生)
"Some people die at 25 and are buried at 75." (living as a walking corpse)
人生自古誰無死，留取丹心照汗青。
Since ancient times, who among us has escaped death? Leave a loyal heart to shine in history.
死亡不是生命的終結，遺忘才是。
Death is not the end of life; forgetting is.
未知死，焉知生？未知生，焉知死？
If you do not know death, how can you know life? If you do not know life, how can you know death?
活著時，想到死亡；死亡時，會否想到永生？
In life, think of death; in death, will you think of eternity?
人終究要死，但問題是：是否真的活過？
Everyone eventually dies. The question is: did you really live?
